jobs.description:
Who we are

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

- Proactively hunt for top-tier talents across the GCE region markets using LinkedIn Recruiter, local job boards and social networks
- Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified candidates for recurring profiles to reduce time-to-hire across al target countries
- Manage the entire end-to-end recruitment process from job briefing to offer acceptance while using SAP SuccessFactors
- In close collaboration with your HRBP and Hiring Manager, you transform business goals into an operational recruitment strategy and provide market insights on salary trends and talent availability specific to their location
- Maintain accurate data in the ATS and provide updates and reportings on recruitment KPIs to support the Operational Workforce Planning
- Manage the pre-onboarding phase to ensure engagement between offer acceptance and Day 1. Thereby you facilitate a smooth handover to the HR Country / HR Admin
- As brand ambassador for Magellan Partners group, you ensure a high-quality candidate experience, participate at university hiring events and maintain relationships with alumni networks to drive referrals
- You will be responsible for adapting and tailoring global campaigns to ensure they fit the specific cultural and business nuances of markets as diverse as the DACH region and Eastern Europe

Who Are We Looking For

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:

- You have 3-5+ years experience in Talent Acquisition in Germany. Additional experience in Switzerland, Austria and/or Eastern Europe is a strong plus
- You are a "hunter" who enjoys the thrill of finding the perfect candidate with demonstrated mastery of LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools
- Ability to manage high volumes of recruitment without compromising the candidate’s experience
- You enjoy working in a matrix organisation where you report to HRBP and collaborate closely with the Business Leads
- With your excellent interpersonal skills you engage candidates and advise managers
- Adopting and promoting the use of digital HR tools (SuccessFactors) and Generative AI comes easily to you
- Fluent in English and German, spoken and written. Additional language skills in French, Italian or Romanian are considered as asset

Shape the evolution

We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.

Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

Your ContributionAs Senior Product Owner – CRM, you drive the evolution of our Odoo-based CRM and ERP platforms and ensure they continuously support our business objectives. You combine product ownership with a strong focus on business process excellence, challenging existing ways of working and identifying opportunities for simplification and automation. Acting as the bridge between business and technology, you align stakeholders across functions and countries around a shared product vision. Through continuous improvement of customer, operational, and financial processes, you help create better customer experiences, higher efficiency, and scalable business operations.
Menu of ResponsibilitiesIn this role, you take ownership of our CRM and ERP landscape and drive continuous improvement across business-critical processes:
• Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for our Odoo-based CRM and ERP platforms, aligned with business strategy and customer experience goals.
• Analyse, challenge, and continuously improve end-to-end business processes across Order-to-Cash, billing, payments, customer management, logistics, procurement, and finance.
• Own and prioritise the product backlog, translating business needs and process improvement opportunities into clear user stories and deliverables.
• Partner with Sales, Finance, Customer Experience, Support, Operations, Logistics, and Data teams to align priorities and maximise business value.
• Lead collaboration with implementation and service partners, ensuring solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and expected outcomes.

Ingredients for Success
• Proven experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or a similar role within CRM, ERP, or business systems environments.
• Strong understanding of commercial, operational, financial, and logistics processes, with the ability to identify and drive process improvements.
• Experience managing product backlogs, priorities, and stakeholder expectations within agile ways of working.
• Excellent communication and facilitation skills, enabling alignment and decision-making across diverse stakeholder groups.
• Customer-focused mindset combined with a passion for continuous improvement, operational excellence, and measurable business outcomes.
• Experience working with CRM and ERP platforms; knowledge of Odoo is beneficial. Fluent English is required.

As part of the German government's artificial intelligence (AI) strategy, the successful Saxon competence center ScaDS.AI Dresden/Leipzig (Center for Scalable Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence) is being expanded into a leading German AI competence center for Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (AI). For TUD Dresden University of Technology, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.

At the **Center for Interdisciplinary Digital Sciences (CIDS),** the **Department for Scalable Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence (ScaDS.AI Dresden)** offers two full-time positions as

Research Associate / PhD Student / PostDoc (m/f/x)
(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)

starting November 1, 2026. The positions are limited to two years, with the option of extension. The period of employment is governed by the Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG). A shorter contract term is possible by arrangement. The positions aim at obtaining further academic qualification.

Professional assignment: Chair of Scalable Software Architectures for Data Analytics (Prof. Dr. Michael Färber)

Research areas: Natural Language Processing, Large Language Models, Knowledge Graphs, and related fields (e.g., Graph Machine Learning)

**Tasks:** 

- scientific research in at least one of the above-mentioned research areas
- collaboration in national and international research projects, possibly with an industrial collaboration
- participation in teaching (e. g., seminars; no basic lectures)
- presentation and publication of research results in top-tier conferences/journals
- co-supervision of Bachelor’s/Master’s students in small projects or theses
- assist with proposal writing for research funding, if applicable

**Requirements:** 

- university degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Mathematics, Advanced Information Science and Engineering, or a related field 
- prior research experience (publications, theses, projects) in the above-mentioned research areas is a strong plus
- strong interest in foundational research in the above-mentioned research areas
- excellent programming skills (experience with deep learning frameworks preferred)
- good written and spoken English skills
- highly motivated and able to work independently and in teams

The position comes with access to high-performance computing resources (https://compendium.hpc.tu-dresden.de/jobs_and_resources/overview/) and access to training opportunities within ScaDS.AI.

TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The university is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment.

Application: Please submit your detailed application with the usual documents (e.g., cover letter, CV, and other supporting documents), quoting the job reference “ScaDS.AI Färber E 13” by September 15, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de by sending it as a single pdf file to jobs-scads.ai@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:jobs-scads.ai@tu-dresden.de) or to:

TU Dresden, ScaDS.AI, Prof. Dr. Michael Färber, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.

Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.

TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.

Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website: https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .

JOIN OUR TEAM IN BONN FOR A FULL-TIME UNLIMITED POSITION, STARTING ASAP as

AUDITOR FINANCE (M/F/X) 
 

The vision and mission of the DHL Group Audit function reflect the function’s ambition for being closer to the business. We as Internal Audit create and deliver value for the group by providing independent and objective audit services for DHL’s key stakeholders. This ambition is reemphasized through our 3 main objectives:
 

Our task is to assure good governance and safeguard the company’s assets.

We provide advice to continuously optimize business processes and the Internal Control System.

We accompany the organization in achieving its objectives by providing clear and transparent audit conclusions.
 

Join our great team in Bonn and be a part of our vibrant community of professionals from over eighteen different countries. We value your expertise, passion, and open mindset, and we cannot wait to welcome you aboard. Embrace the opportunity to work in a diverse and inclusive environment where your unique skills and perspectives will be celebrated. Apply now and let us embark on an exciting journey together!
   

YOUR TASKS 
* Conduct process and risk-based audit assignments across all processes related to Finance topics (e.g. accounting, taxes, treasury), including the following tasks:
+ Preparation of audit assignments and audit programs
+ Preparation and participation in opening and closing meetings
+ Performing interviews, data analysis (incl. collection and processing)
+ Documentation of audit results in accordance with agreed standards
+ Delivering high quality audit results and reports
* Build and maintain relationships with auditees and key stakeholders of audited entities,
* Contribute to the development and implementation of principles, standards and methods for the Finance audit function as well as the development of audit programs

   

YOUR BENEFITS 
* Attractive salary package in accordance with the collective agreement of Deutsche Post AG; capital gains benefits and possibility of salary conversion into additional free time
* Company pension or other forms of financial security ensuring a comfortable and stable income during your golden years.
* Salary conversion for environmentally-friendly commuting by leasing of company bike
* Flexible working arrangements, such as part-time options or remote work possibilities,
* Health and well-being initiatives, such as sabbaticals or measures to promote a healthy work-life balance incl. health management initiatives, including preventive check-ups, sports activities
* Work-family balance by offering company day care facilities in Bonn and cooperation with pme Familienservice, offering services such as childcare during school holidays
* Opportunities for further education and development, such as training / mentoring programs, workshops, or support for professional growth. Fast-paced development opportunities driven by best practices and cutting-edge solutions, keeping up with the latest trends and technologies
* Present the audit results to local senior management in persuasive closing presentations, highlighting your expertise and delivering valuable insights.
* Emphasis on respect and results and the opportunity to make a positive impact, such as through corporate social responsibility initiatives or involvement in charitable projects, Go Teach, Go Help, Global Volunteer Day, taking part in team-building activities or company event, such as summer party, Bonn Marathon etc.
* Subsidized Germany-wide public transportation ticket and various employee discounts and offers from external providers

     

YOUR PROFILE
* University degree in relevant discipline (e.g. Accounting, Finance or Business Administration) or comparable qualifications
* First experience gained in an accounting firm or within an internal audit department
* Knowledge of IFRS and finance-related processes and controls
* Affinity for data analytics and openness for innovation (AI, large language models)
* Excellent command of German and English (written and spoken); comfortable in multicultural settings
* Very good communication skills and quick comprehension
* Distinct analytical and conceptual abilities
* Flexibility and willingness for business travel in Germany and internationally (based on needs)

  

We are looking forward to your application.

jobs.description:
Your creative fieldWe are looking for a Team Lead Group Accounting (all genders) to join us as soon as possible in a full-time, permanent position. We operate remote-first, but you can choose to work hybrid or fully on-site depending on your proximity to one of our locations. As a large part of our Finance team is based in the Cologne area, this location may be particularly convenient.

As a Group Accountant, you take on central responsibility for the preparation of the consolidated financial statements of the Contabo Group in accordance with IFRS. Together with the Finance team – including General Ledger, Accounting, and Controlling – you develop and analyze monthly internal group reporting as well as reporting for banks. Your role goes beyond working with numbers: you actively shape processes, optimize systems, and contribute to the continuous development of your area of responsibility.You are also responsible for the functional and disciplinary leadership of currently two General Ledger Accountants. Together, you act as a key point of contact for external auditors as well as internal stakeholders such as the tax department.As we continue to grow throughout 2026, the complexity of our business and the Finance function will further increase. To ensure that this growth and the associated changes are accurately reflected in our accounting and financial statements, we are looking for you.While we already have a well-established team, new perspectives, different experiences, and fresh ideas are always welcome. We encourage you to take the time to review and challenge existing processes within your area of responsibility. If you identify potential improvements, we expect you to act on them — giving you the opportunity to make a real impact and leave your mark.

What convinces usYour personality, combined with:
• a degree in economics or a business administration background with relevant additional qualifications
• In-depth knowledge of IFRS and HGB
• Experience with Lucanet or other consolidation systems
• Your excellent analytical skills
• Excellent English skills for communicating with your international colleagues
• Three to five years of professional experience in auditing or corporate accounting
• Initial leadership experience (preferred) and the desire to further develop your own area of responsibility within the team
• Commitment and a sense of responsibility

Awesome ProspectsAt Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.Additionally, we offer:
• Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
• Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
• Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities
• Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
• Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve
• Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day
• Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom
• Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment
• Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
• Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity
• Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget

How to reach usIf you have any questions, you can reach out to Max by email at maximilian.kasemir@contabo.de.

About us Contabo - High-quality Cloud Hosting Made in Germany!

As a leading infrastructure service provider in the field of cloud instances and dedicated servers, we have stood for first-class quality, reliability and favorable prices since our foundation in Munich in 2003. Meanwhile, more than 275,000 customers in over 190 countries trust our services.

We specialize in providing German quality to users worldwide, focusing on the stability and security of our data centers, the optimization of internal processes, and excellent customer support.

Become a part of our future-oriented company, which plays a significant role in the development of digital cloud hosting, and support us with your ideas and commitment.

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

 

As a Digital Services Business Partner (f/m/d) for Transformer Factories, you act as the key interface between local business stakeholders and Siemens Energy's global IT and Digital Services organizations. Your focus is on strategically evolving the site's digital and IT landscape, driving the implementation of digital and IT initiatives, and ensuring that these services deliver measurable business value.

 

How You’ll Make an Impact
* Serve as a Trusted Advisor and Digital Connector between local stakeholders and all relevant IT and Digital Services functions
* Represent business priorities through a deep understanding of site requirements and the ability to translate them into effective IT and digital decisions
* Take end-to-end ownership of Digital Services initiatives, IT projects, and IT services at the site
* Align the site's digital and IT landscape with the Siemens Energy IT and Digital Strategy in collaboration with global Business Partners and the IT reference architecture
* Analyze, prioritize, and govern digital and IT demands, including business case development, investment justification, governance, and Go/No-Go decision-making
* Budget Management: Own and manage the site's Digital Services and IT budget, including planning, forecasting, cost control, investment prioritization, and ensuring optimal business value from digital and IT spending
* Driving Digitalization: Identify, develop, and implement digital solutions that optimize business processes and enhance operational performance
* Security, Compliance & Governance: Ensure adherence to Cyber Security and Information Security requirements, support audits and escalations, and drive compliance with standards such as ISO 27001
* Act as a Change & Transformation Agent for digital, IT, and harmonization initiatives across Siemens Energy

What You Bring
* University degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Information Systems, or a comparable qualification
* Initial professional experience in an IT and/or Digital Services environment
* Strong Business Partner mindset with a customer and value-oriented approach
* Excellent communication and presentation skills in both German and English
* Initial experience in supporting manufacturing sites or business units from a strategic IT or digital perspective
* Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to prepare complex topics for management and executive audiences
* Knowledge of IT project management, demand and portfolio management, and business case development
* Experience in budget planning, financial management, cost optimization, and IT investment governance is an advantage
* Familiarity with data-driven manufacturing, Industrial Data Platforms, and OT/IT integration is beneficial
* Understanding of governance, compliance, and audit requirements, particularly ISO 27001
* Strategic mindset combined with strong business acumen and a service-oriented approach

About the Team 

Our Grid Technology team enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.00 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo 

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits
* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder

jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Legal Counsel – Employment & Labor Law (f/m/x) to lead our Social Affairs function across Germany & CEE (Austria, Romania and Czech Republic). Based in Germany, in this strategic role, you will be the architect of our social dialogue for Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic. You will not only provide expert legal advice but also lead direct relationships with Employee Representatives and Works Councils in all four countries. You are responsible for negotiating agreements, ensuring compliance, and fostering a constructive social climate to support the Group’s transformation and growth in the region.

Day-to-day responsibilities

Regional Social Dialogue (DE, AT, RO, CZ)

- Germany (Betriebsrat): Lead negotiations on complex shop agreements (Betriebsvereinbarungen) regarding IT systems, mobile work, and restructuring. Manage co-determinationrights (Mitbestimmung) effectively.
- Austria (Betriebsrat): Lead the relationship with the Austrian Works Council. Navigate the specificities of the Austrian "Social Partnership" and negotiate local shop agreements in compliance with the Arbeitsverfassungsgesetz (ArbVG).
- Romania (Reprezentanții salariaților) and Czech Republic (Odborová organizace): Lead the relationship with the Works Councils.
- Harmonization: Ensure a consistent social strategy across Germany & CEE cluster while respecting local legislative nuances.

Employment Law Advisory

Legal Business Partner: Serve as the primary legal advisor to the HR Country 

- Individual Labor Law: Manage complex individual cases across the region: drafting termination notices, negotiating mutual separation agreements (Aufhebungsverträge / Mutual Termination Agreements), and handling disciplinary measures.
- Contracts: Maintain and update standard employment contract templates for Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic to ensure they remain compliant with the latest local case law.

Restructuring & Strategic Projects

- Transformation Support: Legally structure and execute organizational changes across the region (e.g.,§613a BGB transfers in Germany, AVRAG transfers in Austria).
- Compliance: Roll out Group compliance policies (GDPR, Whistleblowing, Code of Conduct) ensuring they meet the strict data privacy standards of Germany and the specific requirements of the Austrian market.

Litigation Management

- Dispute Resolution: Represent the company in labor court proceedings (Kündigungsschutzklagen) in Germany.
- External Supervision: Select and manage external legal counsel in Austria, Romania and Czech Republic for specific litigation or high-risk cases, ensuring cost control and alignment with Group strategy.

Who are we looking for

Experience & Qualifications

- 8 to 10+ years of experience in Labor Law/Social Affairs, preferably within an international matrix organization, an IT/Consulting firm, or a specialized law firm.
- Works Council Leadership: Mandatory experience leading negotiations with Works Councils.
- You must have deep expertise in the German Betriebsverfassungsgesetz.
- You must have experience or a strong capability to manage Austrian employee representation bodies.
- Regional Scope: Proven ability to manage legal topics across multiple jurisdictions (Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic).

Competencies

- Negotiation Skills: Ability to lead social dialogue in four different legal environments (example: co-determination of Germany).
- Pragmatism: Solution-oriented mindset; you enable business while managing risk.
- Languages: German (Native level) and English (Fluent) are required. French is a plus.

Perks & Benefits

- Regional Responsibility: A key role covering four distinct countries with strategic importance.
- Autonomy: You will be the lead expert for the region Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic, trusted to handle sensitive negotiations with the collaboration of the HR Country Manager.
- Transformation: The opportunity to accompany a high-growth group in structuring its social foundations in the German & CEE market.
